app.title: LoopTune
home.heading: This is LoopTune
home.tagline: Metronome, Pitch Pipe, Tuner and Looper all in one place
home.metronome: Keep steady time with an adjustable tempo, time signature and accented first beat. Tap along to find a tempo.
home.pitchpipe: Play any reference note, or the open strings of your instrument, to tune by ear.
home.tuner: Play a note and see through your microphone how sharp or flat it is.
home.looper: Record layers over a metronome, stack them into a loop and export every take.
